trigger:protect_landlet_candidate_ring_m.sql: CREATE TRIGGER protect_landlet_candidate_ring_member_delete BEFORE DELETE ON landlet_candidates WHEN OLD.ring_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'generated ring candidates are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER protect_landlet_candidate_ring_member_geometry BEFORE UPDATE OF area_m2, center_x_m, center_y_m, landlet_class, landlet_type, biome, elevation_m, polygon_json, ring_id ON landlet_candidates WHEN OLD.ring_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'generated ring candidates are immutable'); END

trigger:reject_mismatched_adjacent_landl.sql: CREATE TRIGGER reject_mismatched_adjacent_landlet_candidate_ring BEFORE INSERT ON landlet_candidate_rings WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM landlet_candidate_rings WHERE (ABS(outer_radius_m - NEW.inner_radius_m) <= 0.0000001 OR ABS(inner_radius_m - NEW.outer_radius_m) <= 0.0000001) AND COALESCE(boundary_signature, '') <> COALESCE(NEW.boundary_signature, '') ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'generated ring boundary mismatch'); END

trigger:reject_overlapping_landlet_candi.sql: CREATE TRIGGER reject_overlapping_landlet_candidate_ring BEFORE INSERT ON landlet_candidate_rings WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM landlet_candidate_rings WHERE inner_radius_m < NEW.outer_radius_m - 0.0000001 AND outer_radius_m > NEW.inner_radius_m + 0.0000001 ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'generated ring radial overlap'); END

trigger:users_fleet_never_admin_insert.sql: CREATE TRIGGER users_fleet_never_admin_insert BEFORE INSERT ON users WHEN NEW.is_fleet = 1 AND NEW.is_admin = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A fleet account can never be an admin'); END

trigger:users_fleet_never_admin_update.sql: CREATE TRIGGER users_fleet_never_admin_update BEFORE UPDATE ON users WHEN NEW.is_fleet = 1 AND NEW.is_admin = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A fleet account can never be an admin'); END

trigger:validate_landlet_candidate_ring_.sql: CREATE TRIGGER validate_landlet_candidate_ring_adjacency_parent BEFORE INSERT ON landlet_candidate_rings WHEN NEW.adjacent_to_ring_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM landlet_candidate_rings AS parent WHERE parent.ring_id = NEW.adjacent_to_ring_id AND ABS(parent.outer_radius_m - NEW.inner_radius_m) <= 0.0000001 AND COALESCE(parent.boundary_signature, '') = COALESCE(NEW.boundary_signature, '') ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'generated ring adjacency parent mismatch'); END
